entries.en: A small but sharp claw once used for digging tunnels.
entries.zh: 小巧却锋利的爪子,曾用来挖掘隧道。

entries.en: A small coin depicting a wrinkly, bearded frog. Coins of this nature are said to bring good luck when thrown into small fountains or ponds.
entries.zh: 一枚小硬币,上面刻着一只满脸褶皱、长着胡须的青蛙。据说把这样的硬币投入小喷泉或池塘,就能带来好运。

entries.en: A small piece of a giant glacier. Doesn't ever melt.
entries.zh: 取自巨大冰川的一小块碎片,永不融化。

entries.en: A splendid wool found nowhere else; it caresses your fingers and exudes a unique warmth the likes of which you have never experienced before, and likely never will again.
entries.zh: 一种别处寻不到的华美羊毛；它轻抚你的指尖，散发出独一无二的温暖——你此前从未体会过，往后恐怕也再难遇到。

entries.en: A splendid, yet tiny crown; just about the right size for your pet!
entries.zh: 一顶华丽却小巧的王冠；大小刚好适合你的宠物!
一团湿漉漉、软趴趴的糊状物。

entries.en: A stick of a sweet-smelling incense. It makes you feel at ease.
entries.zh: 一支香气甜美的熏香,令人心绪安宁。

entries.en: A tail ending in a thick club that was used to fend off predators.
entries.zh: 尾端长着厚重骨槌,曾用来抵御掠食者。

entries.en: A terrifying sphere of extreme spookiness.
entries.zh: 一颗散发着极致诡悚气息的恐怖圆球。

entries.en: A ticking time bomb to new life. Acquired using Berberis Blowgun.
entries.zh: 通向新生命的定时炸弹。使用小檗吹箭筒获取。

entries.en: A torn article of men's clothing, waterlogged and mossy. Probably too late to ask for a refund.
entries.zh: 一件破烂的男装,浸透了水,还长满苔藓。现在想退货,大概已经晚了。

entries.en: A truly magnificent egg is nestled within - that much you can tell by weight alone.
entries.zh: 里面安放着一颗无比华美的蛋——光凭这沉甸甸的分量，你就能感觉得到。

entries.en: A very powerful piece of equipment originating from the Rift Dimension.
entries.zh: 一件来自裂隙维度的强大装备。

entries.en: A very strange find once found inside the carcass of a Ghast. It seems like they enjoy a snack that is out of this world from time to time.
entries.zh: 曾在恶魂残骸里找到的怪东西。看来它们时不时也爱来点天外来的零嘴。

entries.en: A vial of particularly clear water,
entries.zh: 一小瓶格外清澈的泉水，

entries.en: A well-preserved fossil featuring a coiled shell.
entries.zh: 一块保存完好的化石,带着螺旋状外壳。

entries.en: A well-preserved set of neural spines. Whatever possessed these was an adept swimmer.
entries.zh: 一组保存完好的背部骨刺。长着它们的生物想必是游泳好手。

entries.en: A well-wrapped present that's hot to the touch.
entries.zh: 包装精美的礼物，摸上去烫烫的。

entries.en: A well-written paper, complete with labeled diagrams. It explores frog biodiversity and details key efforts made in the name of conservation.
entries.zh: 一篇写得很好的论文,还配有标注齐全的图表。它探讨了蛙类的生物多样性,并详述了为保护它们所付出的重要努力。

entries.en: A wise novel once thought to be the cure to all problems.
entries.zh: 一本充满智慧的书，曾被视为解决所有难题的良方。

entries.en: A wooden barrel, stuffed to the brim with riches of all sorts. The lid won't even fit on it!
entries.zh: 一只木桶，里面塞满了各式各样的财宝，连桶盖都盖不上了!

entries.en: Adds %1$s Strength and %2$s Speed to all your Axes.
entries.zh: 你的所有斧头获得 %1$s  力量与 %2$s  速度。

entries.en: Advances the time of all minions
entries.zh: 使岛上所有小人的工作时间快进

entries.en: After not taking damage for %1$ss, gain %2$sx this weapon's  Strength for %3$ss.
entries.zh: 连续 %1$s 秒未受到伤害后，获得相当于此武器  力量的 %2$s 倍的力量加成，持续 %3$s 秒。

entries.zh: 消灭吸血鬼后，你的下一击造成 %1$s 倍  伤害，下一次击杀吸血鬼时获得 %2$s 倍战斗经验。

entries.en: Aim at Timite Ores to wackify their time.
entries.zh: 瞄准时晶矿石，扰乱其时间形态。

entries.en: Aim at a Living Metal Snake to deeply calm it, allowing another player to mine it.
entries.zh: 瞄准活体金属蛇，使其平静下来，以便另一位玩家开采。

entries.en: All men can see the tactics whereby I conquer, but what none can see is the strategy out which victory is evolved.
entries.zh: 人皆知我所以胜之形，而莫知吾所以制胜之形。

entries.zh: 位于末地时，此装备的全部属性提升 %1$s 倍!

entries.zh: 可疑的东西总是红色的。

entries.zh: 右键点击尚未解锁的种植槽位,即可解锁温室中的额外种植槽位。

entries.zh: 跟西瓜切丁器 Mk. II 几乎一模一样，但名字里写着 Mk. III!

entries.zh: 对熔岩和悬空液体同样有效!

entries.zh: 在地牢中始终指向最近的秘密。

entries.en: An ancient plant imbued with the unyielding power of truth.
entries.zh: 蕴含着不屈真理之力的远古植物。

entries.en: An empty bottle. Something in the back of your mind tells you it would be really useful to store a Scatha in it.
entries.zh: 一个空瓶子。冥冥之中有种直觉: 用它来装一只斯卡萨再合适不过了。

entries.en: An extremely fragile but powerful bow, capable of damaging Thorn, despite him being a spirit!
entries.zh: 这张弓极其脆弱却威力惊人，哪怕索恩是灵体也能伤到他!

entries.en: An item treasured by the greatest Dwarf who ever lived. Why would he leave it behind?
entries.zh: 有史以来最伟大的矮人曾珍视之物。究竟因何缘故，他会将其遗落在此?

entries.zh: 一本被翻得卷了边的旧手册，详细讲解了如何对付各类害虫。其中许多害虫如今似乎已经绝迹了——看来有人干得相当漂亮!

entries.en: An unnatural, nigh-unbreakable material. Of those unlucky few who have discovered where it originates, none have lived to tell the tale.
entries.zh: 一种反常且近乎坚不可摧的材料。那些不幸发现其源头的少数人，无一活着回来讲述这段经历。

entries.en: Though far too small to be habitable, it reminds a certain creature of home.
entries.zh: 虽小得无法住下,却能让某个小家伙想起家乡。

entries.en: Though it leaves a lot to be desired,
entries.zh: 但大概饱含了满满的心意。

entries.en: Though it may not be bluer visually, it is in spirit.

entries.en: Throw it back when they are present. By he who is both false idol and beacon of hope.
entries.zh: 趁他们现身时，把它扔回去。就在那位既是伪神、又是希望灯塔的存在身旁。

entries.en: Throw the spear like an arrow which will return to you.
entries.zh: 像射箭一样掷出长矛，长矛随后返回你身边。

entries.en: Throw your Halberd, damaging all enemies in its path, dealing %1$s% melee damage. Consecutive throws cost %2$sx more mana and deal %3$sx more damage than the previous. (max %4$sx)
